ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the image is a table with two rows and three columns; the first row successively marks three genotypes AA, Aa, aa; the genotype frequencies corresponding to the second row are respectively AA=36%, Aa=45%, aa=?%. Then reason: the sum of the three genotype frequencies should be 100%, so the frequency of aa is 100%-36%-45%=19%. Calculate allele frequencies according to the observed genotype frequencies: p(A)=f(AA)+0.5f(Aa)=0.36+0.5×0.45=0.585; q(a)=f(aa)+0.5f(Aa)=0.19+0.5×0.45=0.415. If this population conforms to Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium, then the expected genotype frequencies are AA=p²≈0.342, namely 34.2%; Aa=2pq≈0.486, namely 48.6%; aa=q²≈0.172, namely 17.2%. Compared with the observed values in the image, AA's 36% is higher than the expected 34.2%, aa's 19% is higher than the expected 17.2%, while Aa's 45% is lower than the expected 48.6%. This shows that the two types of homozygotes are relatively more numerous, and heterozygotes are relatively fewer, conforming to the characteristics of homozygote advantage.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：表格列出 AA、Aa、aa 三类基因型频率，AA=36%，Aa=45%，aa 为问号。根据频率总和为 100%，求得 aa=19%。再计算等位基因频率：p(A)=0.36+0.5×0.45=0.585，q(a)=0.19+0.5×0.45=0.415。根据 Hardy-Weinberg 平衡，期望 AA≈p^2=34.2%，Aa≈2pq=48.6%，aa≈q^2=17.2%。与图中观察值比较，AA 和 aa 两类纯合子均偏高，而 Aa 杂合子偏低，因此推断该人群中可能发生纯合子优势。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个两行三列的表格，第一行依次标出三种基因型 AA、Aa、aa；第二行对应的基因型频率分别为 AA=36%、Aa=45%、aa=?%。

再推理：三种基因型频率总和应为 100%，所以 aa 的频率为 100%-36%-45%=19%。根据观察到的基因型频率计算等位基因频率：p(A)=f(AA)+0.5f(Aa)=0.36+0.5×0.45=0.585；q(a)=f(aa)+0.5f(Aa)=0.19+0.5×0.45=0.415。若该群体符合 Hardy-Weinberg 平衡，则期望基因型频率为 AA=p²≈0.342，即 34.2%；Aa=2pq≈0.486，即 48.6%；aa=q²≈0.172，即 17.2%。与图中观察值比较，AA 的 36% 高于期望 34.2%，aa 的 19% 高于期望 17.2%，而 Aa 的 45% 低于期望 48.6%。这说明两类纯合子相对偏多、杂合子相对偏少，符合纯合子优势的特征。
